confirmed_findings: Propeller 240235 is a native type-10 goober: Lock 1690, quest 38060, Data2/event 44654 and Data10/spell 0. GameObject::Use executes the event before checking active quest; event scripts grant marker 92475 before attempting its summon. A failed spawn could leave a start marker without an encounter.

The installed controller runs four bat-rider spawns at 6/11/16/21 seconds, then help after another 60 seconds. Its Dreadwing 92547 reaches waypoint 16 and casts 210262. Installed SpellEffect proves that spell is a self dummy with no helper summon; no matching helper summons or spell-script binding complete the Rogers/Overspark/Vethir bridge.

Original Vethir health-percent SmartAI polling grants monster marker 90907 to players within 40 yards. It is not a before-damage surrender and can be skipped by a lethal hit. Successful surrender must acknowledge the exact encounter boss and owner, including the owner of a pet.

Ground propeller 127609 is at Z=526.777. Exact elevated copy 114500 has the same XY/phase at Z=536.777; native map/VMAP ground at its XY is 526.618. Only the matching elevated duplicate is removed, with phase, position, orientation, spawnMask, state and personal_size guards.

Thane Wildsky 91571 has an ordinary map-1220 Stormheim spawn 289127, real loot ID 91571, valid 98..110 scaling and head quest item 122746. Quest-required head row retains Chance=98.9921, LootMode=0, GroupId=0 and count 1. LootTemplate::Process accepts zero mask for this ordinary ungrouped row.

The actual sparse ItemSparse record, read by the production DB2 loader, has MaxCount=0, Stackable=1, Bonding=4, LimitCategory=0. QuestData marks an item objective as DELIVER at load despite addon SpecialFlags=0. Real ItemAddedQuestCheck/ItemRemovedQuestCheck update 38362; real CanRewardQuest requires the head in carried inventory.

38060 has the original Rogers enders 90749/92557; 38362 has Nathanos 91158 as starter/ender. The Ancient Trials 38210/38459 are reward-gated by those quests and offered by Muninn 97306/Huginn 97305. implementation: A scoped propeller handler checks live/spawned object, Alliance active quest, real charged pack, range, phase, visibility, LOS, movement/combat restrictions and repeat completion. A successful controller initialization alone gives marker 92475. Existing native GO event rows are preserved; the scoped handler consumes the normal interaction and emits the native custom animation only after a valid summon.

Controller and child actors share the exact owner and phase plus personal visibility. The quest-acceptance lifetime token rejects abandon/reaccept and stale sessions; death, logout/map/phase/range changes, missing actors, flight timeout, boss evade and ten-minute attempt timeout clean up summons and permit retry. Saved start credit is capped and never substitutes for defense success.

Four native bat-rider entries/coordinates/timing/120-second lifetime and Dreadwing 17-point installed flight route/180-second lifetime are preserved. Help actors are placed beside the controller on verified ground after movement callback 16, then speak original 4-second Rogers/Overspark dialogue before Vethir spawns. Help spawn failure aborts and remains retryable. Flight spawning/time passage/unrelated movement never grants defense.

Owned Vethir compares final normalized damage (same float division as DealDamage, which follows creature AI) with GetHealth(attacker)/GetMaxHealth(attacker). Reaching 50 percent or an otherwise lethal player/pet strike zeros damage, stops combat, becomes nonattackable/friendly and acknowledges the exact controller boss once. It flies along the original retreat endpoint. Owned combat actors reject attacks/credit from unrelated players. Later-map/unowned actors delegate to SmartAI.

Personal Rogers stays available after completion until hand-in/cleanup. The native quest end script still removes charged pack on reward. The player hook restores the charged pack for an active/completed Signal Boost when 38058 is rewarded, including login, without modifying boost/mover/pet/warlock paths.

SQL only binds six actor templates/one GO and removes the exact elevated duplicate. It preserves existing custom script bindings, other quests/actors, native objective indexes/sequence/flags, event rows, dialogue and trophy loot.

rejected_hypotheses_and_observed_failure: 44654 initially appeared to be an unrelated spell, but the actual goober layout and GameObject::Use establish it is the event field; no spell-ID substitution was made.

The timed-list last row stores event_type=6, but SetScript9 converts timed-list events according to timerType=2 to SMART_EVENT_UPDATE. That field is not by itself a broken death trigger. MovementInform event type parameter zero is also a wildcard, not proof of a broken MovePoint callback.

LootMode=0 and addon SpecialFlags=0 do not invalidate the trophy. Actual ordinary loot filtering and quest loader/item handlers establish valid behavior; chance and mode are preserved. Native trophy objective Flags2=1 differs from live zero; no speculative change was made because no observed core failure depended on it.

Initial native item inspection using the regular WDC1 Python reader failed because ItemSparse uses sparse records. The native item check now uses the actual production DB2 reader; the failed regular-reader attempt is not treated as item evidence.

Initial extracted test compilation required C++20 for production explicit-this captures and additional inventory/loot service stubs. These fixture issues were repaired before accepting test results; extracted production bodies remain unchanged.
